incidents.source_text: On 14 October, in Omdurman, Khartoum State, armed men stopped an NGO vehicle at an informal checkpoint and stole two phones and cash. No injuries were reported.
incidents.title: Armed men rob NGO vehicle at checkpoint in Omdurman
